item.title: Too stiff to move every morning? Surgeon says it could be a sign of arthritis
item.description: Morning stiffness can also occur due to other conditions like ankylosing spondylitis, vitamin D deficiency, or prolonged inactivity. People who sit for long hours, have poor sleep posture, or do not engage in regular exercise may notice temporary stiffness that improves with stretching and movement.

item.title: Apple UAE stores closed in Abu Dhabi, Dubai and Al Ain over regional unrest
item.description: Apple has temporarily closed its corporate offices and five retail stores across the UAE following escalating regional tensions. The move comes after government guidance urging private companies to reduce in-person work and shift to remote operations for safety.

item.title: Uttarakhand: Indo-Nepal border sealed for elections, suspension bridges closed till March 5 for movement
item.description: The India-Nepal border will remain sealed from March 2 to 5 during Nepal’s elections. Suspension bridges in Uttarakhand connecting to Nepal will also stay closed, halting cross-border movement to ensure peace and security during the voting process.

item.title: Martian winds can power future rovers
item.description: Scientists have estimated near-surface wind speeds on Mars using the orientation data of the Ingenuity Mars Helicopter, as it was buffeted. The research indicates that it is feasible for the next generation of Mars rovers to be powered by wind.

item.title: Iran’s Missile Muscle: What weapons does Tehran have to sustain fight against Israel & US?
item.description: After retaliatory strikes, Iran’s military strength, especially its extensive missile and drone arsenal, is under scrutiny.
